name: Winning Souls
overview: Scripture reveals that winning souls is a wise and righteous pursuit, likened to a tree of life, emphasizing the eternal value of bringing others to Christ. The Great Commission commands believers to make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, underscoring the responsibility to actively teach and lead others to faith. Salvation itself is found in confessing Jesus as Lord and believing in His resurrection, highlighting the essential message that must be shared to win souls for Christ.
